Oneliner

Earth observation and weather monitoring cubesat.
Description

Observation of meteorological phenomena through identification of surface polarization, demonstration of space debris reduction technology:

  • 22mm polarized camera.
  • Deorbit System.
Results

Maintained its performance well for 6 months after settling into orbit. KSAT3U photographed an area 57 km wide and 32 km long in black and white from 540 km above the Earth. The resolution is 30m.
